notes.subject: גואל
notes.rationale: Goel em i wantok bilong klan i baim bek — KJV 'Redeemer', YLT 'a redeemer'; mi tok 'man i baim bek' long pasin bilong klan

notes.subject: ולשבי פשע
notes.rationale: Sapos: 'long ol man i tanim bek long pasin nogut' (KJV/JPS) o 'ol prisna bilong pasin nogut' (YLT); mi bihainim pasin fes

notes.subject: agent
notes.rationale: Hibru i no tok husat i tok 'i kam' — Yahwe o goel em yet; Tok Pisin i no putim nem

translation: Na wanpela man i baim bek i kam long Tsaion, na long ol man long Yakov ol i senisim pasin bilong kunta agenst Yahwe — Yahwe i tok.

tokens.gloss: na long ol man i senisim
